text: Biology is a natural science that studies the phenomena and laws of life. It covers multiple levels ranging from the microscopic molecules and cells to the macroscopic individuals, populations, and ecosystems. The aim is to explore the origin, evolution, structure, function, and interrelationships of life. As one of the core disciplines of natural sciences, it is not only the foundation for understanding the life world but also provides crucial support for the development of fields such as medicine, agriculture, and environmental science.
